results.content: Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance and 59 percent disapprove as of September 7, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. As of Tuesday, the survey had garnered more than 128,600 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.
